title: Tactical Situational Awareness System (TSAS) Logical Architecture

requirements.text: The system shall receive GPS positions from every SAM device and cellular app and display them on a map in near real time.
requirements.source_passage: SL-FT-01 The system shall receive GPS positions...

requirements.text: The system shall store the full position history of every tracked unit and allow playback of any time window.
requirements.source_passage: SL-FT-02 The system shall store the full position history...

requirements.text: The system shall show the last known position and the age of the position for units that stop reporting.
requirements.source_passage: SL-FT-03 The system shall show the last known position...

requirements.text: The system shall support geofences and raise an alert when a unit enters or leaves one.
requirements.source_passage: SL-FT-04 The system shall support geofences...

requirements.text: The map shall display base map, elevation, friendly units, detections, routes and geofences as selectable layers.
requirements.source_passage: SL-MAP-01 The map shall display base map...

requirements.text: The map shall work without internet connectivity using pre-loaded map tiles.
requirements.source_passage: SL-MAP-02 The map shall work without internet connectivity...

requirements.text: The system shall compute a route between two points taking terrain and user-defined no-go areas into account.
requirements.source_passage: SL-RT-01 The system shall compute a route...

requirements.text: The system shall estimate the time of arrival for a unit on a planned route and update it from live positions.
requirements.source_passage: SL-RT-02 The system shall estimate the time of arrival...

requirements.text: The system shall ingest live video from EO sensors and record it.
requirements.source_passage: SL-EO-01 The system shall ingest live video...

requirements.text: The system shall detect and classify people and vehicles in video.
requirements.source_passage: SL-EO-02 The system shall detect and classify...

requirements.text: The system shall track detected objects across frames and assign track IDs.
requirements.source_passage: SL-EO-03 The system shall track detected objects...

requirements.text: The system should provide semantic segmentation of terrain (road, vegetation, building, water).
requirements.source_passage: SL-EO-04 The system should provide semantic segmentation...

requirements.text: The system should detect changes between two images of the same area taken at different times.
requirements.source_passage: SL-EO-05 The system should detect changes...

requirements.text: The system should generate short natural-language captions describing a video clip.
requirements.source_passage: SL-EO-06 The system should generate short natural-language captions...

requirements.text: Detections shall be geo-referenced and shown on the map.
requirements.source_passage: SL-EO-07 Detections shall be geo-referenced...

requirements.text: The system shall normalize messages from heterogeneous sensors into a single common data model.
requirements.source_passage: SL-SF-01 The system shall normalize messages...

requirements.text: The system shall fuse detections from multiple sensors and EO analytics into a single track picture, removing duplicates.
requirements.source_passage: SL-SF-02 The system shall fuse detections...

requirements.text: Operators shall record timestamped diary entries, optionally linked to a unit, track, detection or map location.
requirements.source_passage: SL-OD-01 Operators shall record timestamped diary entries...

requirements.text: Diary entries shall be searchable by text, time and linked object.
requirements.source_passage: SL-OD-02 Diary entries shall be searchable...

requirements.text: An emergency button press on a SAM device shall raise a high-priority alert at the command post and on team-leader apps.
requirements.source_passage: SL-AL-01 An emergency button press...

requirements.text: The system shall send alerts to SW-Watch devices, and the wearer shall be able to acknowledge them; acknowledgements shall be visible at the command post.
requirements.source_passage: SL-AL-02 The system shall send alerts to SW-Watch devices...

requirements.text: The system shall display SAM device equipment status (battery, radio, water) and alert on low battery.
requirements.source_passage: SL-AL-03 The system shall display SAM device equipment status...

requirements.text: SW-Watch devices shall keep time synchronized with the system.
requirements.source_passage: SL-AL-04 SW-Watch devices shall keep time synchronized...

requirements.text: Components shall exchange data through a publish/subscribe messaging layer.
requirements.source_passage: SL-COM-01 Components shall exchange data...

requirements.text: The system shall continue to operate in degraded mode when links to the field are intermittent, and deliver queued messages when the link returns.
requirements.source_passage: SL-COM-02 The system shall continue to operate in degraded mode...

requirements.text: The cellular app shall show the map, own unit, friendly units and alerts, and allow team leaders to send position reports and diary entries.
requirements.source_passage: SL-APP-01 The cellular app shall show the map...

requirements.text: The cellular app shall receive push notifications for high-priority alerts.
requirements.source_passage: SL-APP-02 The cellular app shall receive push notifications...

requirements.text: Position updates shall be displayed with low latency.
requirements.source_passage: SL-NF-01 Position updates shall be displayed with low latency.

requirements.text: The system shall be highly available at the command post.
requirements.source_passage: SL-NF-02 The system shall be highly available...

requirements.text: Position history and diary entries shall be retained for as long as needed for after-action review.
requirements.source_passage: SL-NF-03 Position history and diary entries shall be retained...

requirements.text: The video analytics shall run on GPU hardware available at the command post.
requirements.source_passage: SL-NF-04 The video analytics shall run on GPU hardware...

requirements.text: The system shall scale to the number of units in a battalion.
requirements.source_passage: SL-NF-05 The system shall scale to the number of units...

requirements.text: All data shall remain on-premises at the command post; no data may be sent to public cloud services.
requirements.source_passage: SL-SEC-01 All data shall remain on-premises...

requirements.text: All communication between components and with field devices shall be encrypted and authenticated.
requirements.source_passage: SL-SEC-02 All communication... shall be encrypted and authenticated.

requirements.text: Users shall be authenticated and authorized by role (commander, operator, team leader, analyst).
requirements.source_passage: SL-SEC-03 Users shall be authenticated and authorized...

requirements.text: All operator actions and alerts shall be written to a tamper-evident audit log.
requirements.source_passage: SL-SEC-04 All operator actions and alerts shall be written...

requirements.text: The command-post software shall run on Linux servers, deployable as containers.
requirements.source_passage: SL-DEP-01 The command-post software shall run on Linux servers...

requirements.text: Open-source software is permitted only with licenses compatible with redistribution inside a closed defense product.
requirements.source_passage: SL-DEP-02 Open-source software is permitted only...

requirements.text: The system shall provide a mechanism for team leaders to send position reports via the cellular app.
requirements.source_passage: SL-APP-01 ...allow team leaders to send position reports...

requirements.text: The system shall provide a mechanism for team leaders to send diary entries via the cellular app.
requirements.source_passage: SL-APP-01 ...allow team leaders to ... send diary entries.

open_questions.question: What is the specific numeric threshold for 'low latency' in SL-NF-01?
What is the specific numeric availability target (e.g., 99.9%) for SL-NF-02?
What is the specific retention period for position history and diary entries in SL-NF-03?
What is the specific battalion size (number of units) that the system must scale to in SL-NF-05?
Which specific commercial mobile push-notification service is being considered for SL-APP-02, and does it comply with the on-premises constraint in SL-SEC-01?

components.name: Field Edge Gateway
components.purpose: Aggregates GPS, telemetry, and emergency signals from SAM devices and cellular apps; handles local buffering for intermittent connectivity.
responsibilities: Authenticate field devices via mutual TLS
Buffer position updates during link outages
Forward telemetry to Command Post Core
Relay alerts and push notifications to field devices
runtime_assumptions: Field devices support standard cellular or satellite links
Link latency can vary significantly (TBD)
deployment_assumptions: Deployed on ruggedized edge hardware or cloud-edge hybrid nodes
Must handle concurrent connections for battalion-sized units
quality_constraints: Low latency forwarding when link is available
integration_requirements: Supports proprietary SAM device protocols
Supports standard HTTP/MQTT for cellular apps
design_assumptions: Edge gateway does not perform heavy analytics to conserve power/bandwidth
Local buffer size is sufficient for expected outage durations (TBD)

components.name: Pub/Sub Messaging Backbone
components.purpose: Central asynchronous messaging layer for all inter-component communication, ensuring decoupling and reliability.
responsibilities: Route messages between components
Persist messages for replay if needed (TBD)
Ensure at-least-once delivery semantics
Support topic-based filtering
runtime_assumptions: High throughput required for video metadata and GPS streams
Must survive individual component restarts without data loss (TBD)
deployment_assumptions: Clustered deployment for high availability
Runs on Linux containers
integration_requirements: Standard MQTT or Kafka-like interface
TLS encryption for all connections
design_assumptions: Message payload size is small for GPS/Alerts, large for Video Metadata
Backpressure handling is implemented at the producer level

components.name: Sensor Fusion & Normalization Engine
components.purpose: Normalizes heterogeneous inputs into a common data model and fuses multiple sources (GPS, EO detections) into unified tracks.
responsibilities: Normalize GPS positions from SAM devices and apps
Normalize EO detections into geo-referenced objects
Correlate GPS tracks with EO detections
Deduplicate tracks
Assign unique persistent IDs to units/objects
runtime_assumptions: Temporal alignment of GPS and Video metadata is possible (TBD)
Spatial reference systems are consistent
deployment_assumptions: Stateful service requiring shared memory or database for track history
GPU acceleration not strictly required but beneficial for correlation logic
integration_requirements: Must understand canonical data model schema
Must handle out-of-order messages
design_assumptions: GPS positions are the ground truth for unit location; EO detections are supplementary
Track ID persistence survives system restarts (TBD)

components.name: Map Visualization Service
components.purpose: Manages map state, layers, geofences, and route planning data; serves map tiles and dynamic objects to clients. Stores position history for playback and stale position handling.
responsibilities: Store and serve base map tiles (including offline cache metadata)
Manage geofence definitions and evaluate unit positions against them
Compute routes considering terrain and no-go areas
Estimate ETA based on current position and route
Serve dynamic layer data (units, detections) to clients
Persist full position history for playback (SL-FT-02)
Calculate and display stale position age (SL-FT-03)
runtime_assumptions: Terrain data is available and pre-loaded
Geofence evaluation can be done efficiently in memory or via spatial index
Position history storage scales linearly with unit count and time (TBD)
deployment_assumptions: Runs on Linux servers
May require significant RAM for large map datasets
Requires persistent storage for position history
integration_requirements: Must support standard map tile formats (e.g., MBTiles, XYZ)
Must expose REST/gRPC API for route computation and history playback
Must persist position updates asynchronously
design_assumptions: Offline map tiles are pre-cached on the client side; server only serves metadata and dynamic objects
Geofence checks are triggered by position updates, not continuous polling
Position history is stored in a time-series optimized format within DS-POSITION-HISTORY

components.name: Video Analytics Pipeline
components.purpose: Ingests live video, performs object detection/classification/tracking, and outputs geo-referenced detections.
responsibilities: Ingest RTSP-like video streams from EO sensors
Record video to local storage
Run AI models for person/vehicle detection and classification
Track objects across frames and assign track IDs
Geo-reference detections using sensor metadata
Publish detections to the messaging backbone
inputs: Live Video Streams from EO Sensors
runtime_assumptions: GPU hardware is available and accessible
Video streams are stable and authenticated
Sensor calibration data is accurate and up-to-date
deployment_assumptions: Deployed on GPU-enabled Linux servers
Containerized for easy scaling of analytics workers
integration_requirements: Must support standard video codecs
Must output detections in canonical format
design_assumptions: Video ingestion and analytics are decoupled to allow independent scaling
Geo-referencing is done at the pipeline level using known camera positions

components.name: Alert Management Service
components.purpose: Manages alert lifecycle, including emergency alerts, device status warnings, and geofence violations; handles acknowledgements.
responsibilities: Receive and prioritize emergency alerts
Monitor device status (battery, radio, water)
Process geofence violation events from C-MAP-SVC
Route alerts to appropriate operators/apps
Track alert acknowledgement status
runtime_assumptions: Alert priority levels are well-defined
Acknowledgement latency is critical for emergency alerts
deployment_assumptions: High availability required
Must integrate with push notification service
integration_requirements: Must support push notification protocols
Must interface with mobile apps for acknowledgement
design_assumptions: Alerts are stored persistently for audit and review
Push notification service is abstracted behind this component

components.name: Device Management Service
components.purpose: Manages device registry, time synchronization, and health monitoring for SAM devices and SW-Watches.
responsibilities: Maintain registry of all field devices
Distribute time synchronization signals
Aggregate device health metrics (battery, radio)
Authenticate devices during connection
runtime_assumptions: Devices have basic clock capabilities
Time sync frequency is low (e.g., hourly)
deployment_assumptions: Runs as a lightweight service
Integrates with NTP or proprietary time source
integration_requirements: Must support secure time distribution
Must interface with C-EDGE-GW for telemetry
design_assumptions: Device registry is updated in real-time via messaging
Time sync is not critical for GPS accuracy (GPS provides time)

components.name: Operator Diary Service
components.purpose: Manages creation, storage, and search of operator diary entries linked to units, tracks, or map locations.
responsibilities: Accept diary entries from clients
Link entries to entities (units, tracks, locations)
Index entries for full-text and temporal search
Serve search results to clients
runtime_assumptions: Search queries are not extremely complex
Diary entries are relatively small text blobs
deployment_assumptions: Uses a search-optimized database (e.g., Elasticsearch-like)
Runs on Linux containers
integration_requirements: Must support structured and unstructured search
Must integrate with mobile app for entry submission
design_assumptions: Diary entries are immutable once submitted (audit trail)
Search index is updated asynchronously

components.name: Audit & Compliance Service
components.purpose: Captures all operator actions and system alerts for tamper-evident logging.
responsibilities: Log all user authentication events
Log all critical operator actions (e.g., sending alerts, modifying geofences)
Log system alerts and their lifecycle
Ensure log integrity (hash chaining or similar)
runtime_assumptions: Audit logs are write-once
Log storage is separate from operational data
deployment_assumptions: Runs on Linux servers
May use append-only file system or blockchain-like structure
integration_requirements: Must receive events from all critical services
Must support secure log export for review
design_assumptions: Audit logging does not block operational workflows (async)
Log retention period is defined by policy (TBD)

components.name: Cellular Team Leader App
components.purpose: Provides map visualization, position reporting, diary entry submission, and alert acknowledgement for team leaders.
responsibilities: Display map with offline tiles
Show own unit and friendly units
Send position reports and diary entries
Receive and display alerts
Acknowledge alerts
Handle push notifications
runtime_assumptions: Device has GPS capability
Device has cellular connectivity (intermittent)
Pre-loaded map tiles are available
deployment_assumptions: Runs on iOS/Android devices
App binary is signed and updated via secure channel
integration_requirements: Must support offline map rendering
Must integrate with OS-level push notification service (or on-prem alternative)
design_assumptions: Map tiles are cached locally; app does not fetch them on demand
Position reports are sent via C-EDGE-GW
Push notifications may use a local relay if public cloud is prohibited (see OQ-05)

components.name: Command Post Operator UI
components.purpose: Web-based interface for command post operators to view the full situational picture, manage geofences, and review logs.
responsibilities: Display comprehensive map with all layers
Allow geofence creation/editing
View diary entries and search results
Monitor device status dashboards
Review audit logs (read-only)
runtime_assumptions: Browser supports WebGL for map rendering
Stable high-bandwidth connection within command post LAN
deployment_assumptions: Hosted as static assets served by C-MAP-SVC or separate web server
Runs in modern browsers on Linux workstations
integration_requirements: Must consume REST/WebSocket APIs from backend services
Must support role-based UI elements
design_assumptions: UI is thin client; all logic resides in backend services
Authentication is handled via central auth service (abstracted)

components.name: Configuration & Policy Service
components.purpose: Manages system configuration, user roles, permissions, and geofence definitions.
responsibilities: Define and store user roles and permissions
Manage geofence geometries
Configure system parameters (e.g., stale position thresholds)
Distribute configuration updates to clients
runtime_assumptions: Configuration changes are infrequent
Role definitions are hierarchical
deployment_assumptions: Runs on Linux servers
Database-backed storage
integration_requirements: Must integrate with C-MAP-SVC for geofences
Must integrate with C-ALERT-SVC for alert routing rules
design_assumptions: Configuration is versioned
Geofence data is synchronized to C-MAP-SVC periodically or on change

interfaces.name: Position & Telemetry Ingestion
interfaces.payload: JSON: { device_id, lat, lon, timestamp, battery_level }
interfaces.error_handling: Retry with exponential backoff; buffer locally if messaging layer is down

interfaces.name: Emergency Alert Ingestion
interfaces.error_handling: Immediate retry; fallback to SMS if available (TBD)

interfaces.name: Unified Track Publication
interfaces.payload: JSON: { track_id, type: 'UNIT'|'DETECTION', lat, lon, heading, speed, timestamp, confidence }
interfaces.error_handling: Dropped messages are acceptable for real-time tracking; history is recovered via replay if needed

interfaces.name: Geo-referenced Detection Publication
interfaces.payload: JSON: { track_id, type: 'DETECTION', class: 'PERSON'|'VEHICLE', lat, lon, timestamp, source_sensor_id }
interfaces.error_handling: Dropped messages are acceptable for real-time tracking

interfaces.name: Map State Updates
interfaces.error_handling: Client re-subscribes on disconnect; server maintains last known position

interfaces.name: Geofence Violation Alert
interfaces.error_handling: Retry if messaging layer is down

interfaces.name: Alert Processing
interfaces.error_handling: Persist in DS-ALERTS if processing fails

interfaces.name: Position Report Submission
interfaces.error_handling: Client retries on failure; stores locally for later sync

interfaces.name: Diary Entry Submission
interfaces.payload: JSON: { user_id, text, timestamp, linked_track_id, lat, lon }
interfaces.error_handling: Client retries on failure; stores locally for later sync

interfaces.name: Push Notification Relay
interfaces.error_handling: Best-effort delivery; client polls for missed alerts on reconnect

interfaces.name: Detection Metadata Publication
interfaces.payload: JSON: { track_id, class, lat, lon, timestamp, confidence }
interfaces.error_handling: Dropped messages acceptable for real-time analytics

interfaces.name: Map Data Request
interfaces.error_handling: Return cached state if live data is unavailable
interfaces.security: User JWT Authentication, Role-based Access Control

interfaces.name: Diary Search Request
interfaces.error_handling: Return partial results if search index is rebuilding
interfaces.security: User JWT Authentication, Role-based Access Control

external_systems.name: SAM Device
external_systems.description: Soldier-worn device providing GPS, emergency button, and equipment status (battery, radio, water)

external_systems.name: SW-Watch Device
external_systems.description: Smartwatch-like device for alert acknowledgement and time synchronization

external_systems.name: EO Sensor
external_systems.description: Electro-Optical sensor (camera) providing live video feeds

external_systems.name: Push Notification Service
external_systems.description: Service for delivering push notifications to mobile devices. Must comply with on-premises constraint (SL-SEC-01)

assumptions: OQ-01: Low latency threshold is TBD (open question).
OQ-02: High availability target is TBD (open question).
OQ-03: Retention period for position history and diary entries is TBD (open question).
OQ-04: Battalion size (number of units) is TBD (open question).
OQ-05: Push notification service must be on-premises or compliant with SL-SEC-01; specific vendor TBD.
All communication between components and with field devices is encrypted and authenticated (SL-SEC-02).
Open-source software used is compatible with redistribution inside a closed defense product (SL-DEP-02).
Command post software runs on Linux servers as containers (SL-DEP-01).
risks: Intermittent connectivity in the field may lead to significant delays in position updates and alert delivery.
Video analytics performance may be constrained by available GPU hardware, affecting real-time detection capabilities.
Offline map functionality depends on pre-loaded tiles; updating maps in the field is not supported.
Sensor fusion accuracy depends on precise time synchronization between GPS and video streams.
Scalability to battalion size requires careful load testing of the messaging backbone and database layers.

design_rationale: The architecture adopts a modular service-oriented design centered around an internal Pub/Sub messaging backbone to satisfy the mandatory requirement for component communication and degraded mode operation. By decoupling ingestion from processing, the system ensures that high-volume video streams and GPS pings do not block critical alert handling or map updates. A dedicated fusion layer normalizes heterogeneous inputs into a single canonical model, enabling efficient sensor fusion and unified geospatial visualization. The separation of 'Command Post Core' services from 'Field Edge' gateways allows for independent scaling and resilience; if the link to the field degrades, the command post continues to operate using cached state and queued messages. Offline capabilities are pushed to the mobile client via pre-loaded tile caches, ensuring map functionality without internet. Security is enforced at every boundary with mutual TLS and role-based access control, while all persistent data remains on-premises to meet strict compliance requirements. Position history is now explicitly managed by the Map Visualization Service to support playback and stale position display, leveraging its existing spatial index.
